'''Frei Aycen''' was a noted [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] operating during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. An idealistic woman, she saw through the corruption that plagued the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and was known to steal cargoes and supplies while ensuring that her victims were not harmed in any way. Her pirate fleets consisted of a number of [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighters]] and small transports, all of which were protected by the modified [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]], the ''[[Freejack]]''.
